stage: Post-result descriptive cost decomposition of existing P3B
full_sweep: All41 thresholds, warm/cold, point/simultaneous-supported frozen-grid optima
prefix_sampling: At selected checkpoint K, sampling_seconds=recorded_warm_total-anchor_seconds_attributed-actual_setup_seconds. Never divide full4096-horizon time by a shorter selected K.
unit: Per-step cost is wall-clock for one batched update of512 replicas; not a serial single-replica cost.
identity: S=(K1/K2)*(c1/c2)*D, c_m=prefix_sampling_m/K_m, D=(1+A1/Q1)/(1+A2/Q2), A=anchor+setup,Q=prefix_sampling. Ratios of endpoint factors multiply exactly to S(Nmax)/S(Nmin).
counterfactuals: Sampling-only and removing only anchor attribution are bookkeeping views, not production rankings or rerun experiments.
matched_controls: Compare raw sampling_seconds/K at common validated n,h,horizon and same seed within eachN; canonical h rounding to12 decimals only resolves numerical1e-14 differences. Retain failures explicitly; no success-lane selection.
uncertainty: 10000 paired whole-seed bootstrap, fixed selected(n,h,K) for decomposition; existing reselected-optimum frontier CIs remain separate. Confidence conditional on chosen config/reference and measured implementation. This is an accounting decomposition, not a randomized causal identification of all runtime differences.
